text_block_list.text:
Christmas Eve.
Invited by Symboli Rudolf, I came to the cafeteria—
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Grass-chan!
They just put out more cake over there~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you're eating too much~.
You've already had four of them, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, but it's 'Specially Selected Matcha Cake'!
Doesn't it look delicious~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Carefully selected matcha...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Just looking, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Ehehe, Christmas is the absolute best, I tell ya!

The area was bustling with a large crowd of Umamusume.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, welcome.
Welcome to the Student Council's Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Every year for Christmas, the student council hosts a party.
Events like these are useful for boosting everyone's morale, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, strictly speaking aside,
it'd be lonely to have nothing on Christmas, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, participation is voluntary and people are free to come and go.
Every year, the participation rate is around 50%, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This year's participation rate is 90% of the student body.
In other words, nearly all students are taking part.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the organizer, we are extremely grateful,
but we didn't expect a turnout quite this large.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The student council was bustling about, rushing in every direction.
They were utterly overwhelmed with visitors and tasks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for calling you out here, Trainer,
but please, feel free to enjoy yourself as you like."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to show you around, but...
it seems quite impossible now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
Though I'm sure you'll enjoy it too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... President!
Sorry to interrupt while you're talking!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, would you mind...
t-taking a picture with us!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a photo?
I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it--!
Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry for cutting in!
But I felt like it had to be now...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whenever the President talks with you, Trainer,
she always has such a gentle look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, your inner thoughts are completely leaking out.
There goes your dignity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's be careful not to leave any records.
Now then, getting straight to the point—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry to trouble you, but please do.
Make sure to take a lovely photo of them."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have a request...
President, could you strike an imposing pose with your arms crossed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, but... why?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'd like it with that "Emperor" vibe, please!
I want to capture the President looking cool...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhhhh~~!!
S-So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's this pattern too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hyawaaaaa...!
T-The "Emperor"~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha.
This truly is delightful.

It turned into a delightful Christmas where I got
to see Symboli Rudolf having a whole lot of fun
in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly.
Coming along was the right choice after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President, you must be exhausted working since morning.
Why not go get some fresh air outside?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you're going to put it that way, you're the same.
Weren't you at the academy with me from the crack of dawn?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I took this afternoon off under direct orders from the student council president.
Have you forgotten already?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, well... but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, I will not back down this time. I have already
informed the board members that the President is on a break."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Retracting the announcement now might cause confusion.
Are you sure you want to proceed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...You've been especially merciless lately.
Understood, I'll graciously accept your kindness here."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, if I stay at the venue like this,
I feel as though I might be thrown out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd at least like to leave on my own two feet, but...
Would you mind accompanying me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: âTake a look, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looking down from the rooftop gives a bird's-eye view of the academy.
Though almost all the lights are out now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Look at that light. It's the cafeteria's glow.
...Don't you think it shines quite beautifully in the dark of night?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Every student at our school shines with their own light.
When brought together, it is truly dazzling..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must pour all my energy into this
to make it shine even brighter.
choice_data_list: Then it's my job to make you shine even brighter.
Then I'll be the one to make you shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're quite the smooth talker yourself.
Fufu, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The music has started playing.
Looks like the dance has begun.
choice_data_list: No, I don't hear anything though...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"There is a difference in hearing between Umamusume and humans.
It's only natural that you wouldn't be able to tell."

"...I truly can't hear a thing, but
if she says so, then it must be true."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's probably too late starting now.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to share
a dance with me here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anxious?
Make sure you don't underestimate your opponent, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Allow the “Emperor” herself
to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about it, will you still refuse?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, if you would lend me a hand.
(Smack...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Turn right here... Yeah,
you've got pretty good instincts, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah,
you've found yourself a wonderful partner.

Afterward, we enjoyed a private ballroom dance just the two of us
until Symboli Rudolf was fully satisfied...
